say:1:1220333001:1.text: Thanks to you, the fish were delivered on time. The boss was happy, and I was spared an earful.
say:1:1220333001:1.source_cn: 多亏你们，那些鱼才能按时送给大当家，我也免遭一顿骂。
say:1:1220333001:1.male: Thanks to you, the fish were delivered on time. The boss was happy, and I was spared an earful.
say:1:1220333001:1.female: Thanks to you, the fish were delivered on time. The boss was happy, and I was spared an earful.

say:2:1220333002:1.text: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?
say:2:1220333002:1.source_cn: 你们找我是有什么事吗？我很乐意帮忙！
say:2:1220333002:1.male: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?
say:2:1220333002:1.female: What can I do for you? Do you need help with something?

say:4:1220333003:0.text: Yeah, it's one of our coins. What about it?
say:4:1220333003:0.source_cn: 哦，这是我们的硬币。有什么想问的呢？
say:4:1220333003:0.male: Yeah, it's one of our coins. What about it?
say:4:1220333003:0.female: Yeah, it's one of our coins. What about it?

say:6:1220333004:0.text: Do you know whose coin this belongs to?
say:6:1220333004:0.source_cn: 你知道这是谁的硬币吗？

say:7:1220333005:1.text: Well... Actually, all coins look the same. If you ask me that, it's hard to tell.
say:7:1220333005:1.source_cn: 嗯……其实硬币都长得一样，你这么问，我也——

say:8:1220333006:0.text: Wait, this coin is marked on the back.
say:8:1220333006:0.source_cn: 等等，这枚硬币的背面做了记号。

say:10:1220333008:1.text: Look, it's not that obvious. There's a small knife mark here.
say:10:1220333008:1.source_cn: 喏，不太明显，是用小刀刻上去的。

say:11:1220333009:1.text: Some members do this to distinguish their coins from others.
say:11:1220333009:1.source_cn: 为了将自己的硬币和其他人的区分开，有些成员会这么做。

say:12:1220333010:0.text: I remember someone lost the coin before. What was his name again? I think his name started with a "T".
say:12:1220333010:0.source_cn: 话说，之前好像有人把硬币弄丢了。我记得那个人叫……塔…...

say:15:1220333012:1.text: Yes! Tucker! You know him? This might be his.
say:15:1220333012:1.source_cn: 对！塔克！箱子·塔克。你们竟然认识他？这说不定是他的硬币。
say:15:1220333012:1.male: Yes! Tucker! You know him? This might be his.
say:15:1220333012:1.female: Yes! Tucker! You know him? This might be his.

say:16:1220333013:0.text: We don't really know him, but thanks for the information, Miss Sana.
say:16:1220333013:0.source_cn: 算不上认识……总之，你提供了很重要的情报，谢谢你，赛娜小姐。

say:17:1220333014:0.text:
You're welcome. Is that all?
Remember, if you have any other questions, come find me.
say:17:1220333014:0.source_cn: 啊，这就行了？\n好吧，你们要是有其他的事情，也记得来...
say:17:1220333014:0.male:
You're welcome. Is that all?
Remember, if you have any other questions, come find me.
say:17:1220333014:0.female:
You're welcome. Is that all?
Remember, if you have any other questions, come find me.

say:18:1220333015:0.text: Let's go find Tucker and see what this is all about.
say:18:1220333015:0.source_cn: 这下子必须得找塔克问个清楚了！我们走吧。
say:18:1220333015:0.male: Let's go find Tucker and see what this is all about.
say:18:1220333015:0.female: Let's go find Tucker and see what this is all about.
